subject: Copywriting
title: Slogans vs. Taglines vs. Catchphrases
description: A quick win: understand Slogans vs. Taglines vs. Catchphrases.

hook.text: 'Have It Your Way' is a slogan. 'I'm Lovin' It' is a tagline. 'Where's the Beef?' is a catchphrase.

buildup.text: A slogan defines the brand long-term. A tagline accompanies a specific campaign.

discovery.text: Nike's slogan is 'Just Do It'—permanent. 'Find Your Greatness' was a campaign tagline—temporary. Different lifespans.

twist.text: Some taglines become slogans when a campaign is too good to retire. 'A Diamond Is Forever' started as a campaign line.

climax.text: Understanding the difference helps copywriters pitch correctly: slogans need board approval; taglines need creative.

punchline.text: Slogans are permanent. Taglines are seasonal. Know the difference.

quiz.question: What is the difference between a slogan and a tagline?
options: Slogans are long-term brand identity; taglines are campaign-specific
